title: MegaMine ReIndev
description: MegaMine ReIndev is a legacy console-style Mega Man mashup pack for the b1.7.3 ReIndev mod.
body:
MegaMine is a texture pack that fully converts the aesthetics of Minecraft Reindev (a beta 1.7.3 mod exploring a different branch of development) to the style of the classic Mega Man titles, replacing all of the textures, music, and most sound effects, as well adding more animation and variety to the wide palette of blocks and items.

IMPORTANT: The mod’s ZIP file includes the texture pack as well as a language pack required for certain menus to display properly with the new font, as well as providing many new names, splash texts, and more fun Mega Man theming. Please extract the ZIP first and then follow the instructions in its README. It will not work if you simply place the ZIP into your texture packs folder!

This texture pack is heavily inspired by [CK20XX's Megacraft Classic](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/megacraft-classic), as well as Legacy Console's crossover Mashup Packs, and, obviously, the Mega Man series. More detailed credits are contained in the README.
